title: MusicRadar: 'In actual fact, it's pure maths': just what are Angine de Poitrine actually doing musically? We dissect their biggest track
notes: Fabienk: loops stay in 7/8 while the drums play three bars of 4/4 plus a 2/4, a 14-beat cycle equal to four bars of 7/8; the article calls it metric modulation.
